map.冲奶粉别凭感觉：输入目标奶量与奶粉罐冲调比例（每勺兑水量），自动算所需勺数与水量: Do not mix formula by feel: enter the target milk volume and the can's mixing ratio (water per scoop) and the tool computes the number of scoops and the water needed, avoiding over-concentrated or over-diluted formula.
map.冲调计算：所需勺数 = 目标奶量 ÷ 每勺兑水量；所需水量 = 勺数 × 每勺兑: Mixing calculation: scoops needed = target milk volume / water per scoop; water needed = scoops x water per scoop; convert with the ratio printed on the can (for example 30 mL of water per scoop). A powder-to-water ratio that drifts off makes the formula too strong (high kidney load) or too weak (nutrient deficiency), so always add water first, then powder, and shake well.
map.日常瓶喂冲调：已知目标喂奶量（如 180ml）与罐体标注比例（多为 30ml/勺: Everyday bottle mixing: given the target feed volume (such as 180 ml) and the ratio printed on the can (usually 30 ml/scoop), quickly work out how many level scoops of powder and how much water to add.
map.不同品牌切换：各品牌勺量不同（常见 30ml/勺，部分 60ml/勺），按比例换: Switching brands: scoop sizes differ by brand (commonly 30 ml/scoop, some 60 ml/scoop), so convert by the ratio to avoid over-concentration (kidney load) or over-dilution (nutrient deficiency).
map.外出便携：用「目标量÷比例」反推需带几勺粉，配合保温瓶分装温水，到店现冲保证卫生: Travel and portability: work backwards from "target volume / ratio" to know how many scoops to bring, and carry pre-portioned warm water in a thermos to mix on site for hygiene.
map.勺数 = round(180/30) = 6 勺；水量 = 6×30 = 180: Scoops = round(180/30) = 6 scoops; water = 6 x 30 = 180 ml (add warm water first); total volume after mixing = 180 + round(6 x 4.3) = 180+26 = 206 ml (each scoop of powder is about 4.3 g, so the volume grows slightly once dissolved). That is 6 level scoops of powder plus 180 ml of warm water.
map.务必先加水到刻度再平勺加粉，可避免总体积超标导致过浓。每勺必须刮平（不用堆尖），: Always add water to the mark first and then add level scoops of powder; this avoids exceeding the final volume and ending up too concentrated. Every scoop must be leveled off (not heaped), otherwise the concentration differs from what the can states.
map.多数配方奶建议 40–50°C 温水（部分品牌 40°C），既能溶解又保留活性营: Most formulas recommend 40-50°C warm water (some brands 40°C), which dissolves well while preserving active nutrients; never use boiling water, as it destroys probiotics and protein structure. Feed right after mixing or refrigerate, and do not reheat leftover milk repeatedly.
map.多数奶粉为 30ml/勺，请以罐体标注为准: Most formulas are 30 ml/scoop, follow the label on the can
map.平勺取粉（刮平），先水后粉，水温按罐体说明（通常 40–70°C）: Level scoops (scooped flat), water before powder, temperature per the can instructions (usually 40-70°C)
map.冲调后体积略大于水量，属正常: The volume after mixing is slightly larger than the water, which is normal
map.结果仅供参考，以奶粉罐冲调说明为准: Results are for reference only; follow the mixing instructions on the formula can
